# Introduction

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Introduction

In the singly and circular linked list that we have discussed so far, every node points to its next node only.

![Singly Linked List](data:image/png;base64,)

However, we can also create a linked list where a node points to both its previous and next nodes. This type of linked list is called a doubly linked list.

![Doubly Linked List](data:image/png;base64,)

A doubly linked list, unlike other linked lists, references both the head (first node) and the tail (last node).

Now that we know what doubly linked lists are, let's see why we need them.
